movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Men hold shepherd's crooks entwined with leaves and flowers.
movement_profile.footwork: Ten basic steps divided into four parts.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Line formation with men leading and women following.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, with the hand holding the crook bent at the elbow.

signature_moves.description: Men lead the line carrying decorated shepherd's crooks.
signature_moves.name: Crook procession

music_profile.sound_description: The music consists solely of vocal song, alternating between 7/8 and 2/4 time signatures.

basic_steps: Form a line with men leading and women following.
Hold the shepherd's crook with the hand bent at the elbow.
Execute the ten-step sequence divided into four parts.
teaching.level_notes: Requires coordination of the ten-step sequence and the handling of the shepherd's crook.
